name: Kousaki Chisa
source:
A blunt guy who always says what he's thinking even in front of his girlfriend the protagonist.
He has a bad mouth, but he treasures her very much.
He doesn't show it but he's impatient about how he's still a student and his girlfriend is out in the working world.
He absolutely hates being treated like he's younger.
